quizName: Sign Test Check how well you know road signs.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that left turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?

options.text: There is a steep hill ahead.
No trucks are allowed on an upcoming hill.
There are trucks on an upcoming hill.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a steep hill ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep hill or downgrade is coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This warning sign tells you that a sharp turn is coming. Reduce your speed before you reach the turn.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must bear either right or left.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must bear either right or left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a Y intersection ahead. You must choose to go right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a crossroad is coming up. Be alert for other traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you a roundabout is ahead. Enter slowly and let traffic already in the roundabout go first.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that bicycles may be in the area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that traffic is moving in both directions ahead.

questions.question: When a rider's left arm is extended straight out to the left, what does it mean?
questions.explanation: Riders use hand signals to show their intentions. A left arm extended straight out means the rider plans to turn left or change lanes to the left.

questions.question: When riding in a group, what does it mean when the lead rider raises their left arm and points their index finger?

options.text: The group will pull off at the next exit.

questions.explanation: Hand signals help riders communicate in a group. When the lead rider raises their left arm and points their index finger, it tells all riders to form a single line.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean when riding in a group?
questions.explanation: Hand signals help riders communicate in groups. When the lead rider extends their left arm straight down with their palm facing back, all riders should stop.

questions.question: What type of sign has this shape and color?
questions.explanation: Pennant-shaped signs only warn drivers about no passing zones.

questions.question: What does this sign warn drivers about?

options.text: An upcoming curve in the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: An upcoming curve in the road.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead curves to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead is closed to traffic.
The highway ahead is undergoing maintenance.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead is undergoing maintenance.
questions.explanation: Orange signs warn drivers about construction and maintenance work. This sign tells you that construction is ahead and you should slow down and drive carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must drive slowly and sound your horn.
You are entering a school's parking lot.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you a school zone is coming. Slow down and watch for children.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with yellow background and black markings. This sign warns that wet pavement may be slippery and make your vehicle harder to control.

questions.question: This sign shows one type of:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a T intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.
questions.explanation: This sign means the road ahead will turn sharply right and then sharply left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down if an emergency vehicle is approaching.
Look both ways as you cross the intersection.
Always come to a full stop at the intersection.
Slow down and be prepared to stop if necessary.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be prepared to stop if necessary.
questions.explanation: Slow down when you see a yield sign. Be ready to stop and let other vehicles and pedestrians go first. Stop completely if needed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A series of curves is ahead.
The road will be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road will be slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: What does this sign prevent?

options.text: Entering one-way streets and expressway ramps from the wrong direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: Entering one-way streets and expressway ramps from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road has one-way traffic. You cannot enter from your current direction.

questions.question: At an intersection with a yield sign, what should you do?

options.text: Always stop before entering the intersection.
Yield only to traffic on the right.
Yield only to traffic on the left.
Slow down and let other traffic go first.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and let other traffic go first.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means you must slow down and let other traffic in the intersection go first.

questions.question: What does a stop sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and be ready to stop if cars are coming.
Come to a complete stop, then go when safe.
Proceed carefully through the intersection without always stopping.
Stop only for traffic on crossing roads.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a complete stop, then go when safe.
questions.explanation: A stop sign means you must come to a complete stop. Let all vehicles and pedestrians in or near the intersection pass first. Then go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road curves left, then right.
The road curves right, then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road ahead curves right and then left. Slow down so you can safely handle these curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with yellow backgrounds. This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming. Be ready for a yellow or red light.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When a lead rider extends their left arm straight out with palm down and swings it down, it signals following riders to slow down.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Pedestrians are walking along the road ahead.
Watch for construction workers on the road.

questions.explanation: This sign shows a pedestrian crossing is coming. Drive carefully because pedestrians may be in the area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Keep driving at your current speed.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive carefully and be ready to slow down.
Do not drive in this lane.
Come to a complete stop and yield the right-of-way.
Slow down, be ready to stop, and yield if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, be ready to stop, and yield if needed.
questions.explanation: This triangular sign means yield. Slow down at the intersection and be ready to stop. Let other vehicles, bicycles, and pedestrians pass safely before you go.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a regulation sign that tells drivers what they can and cannot do. This sign means left turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to upcoming hazards. This sign warns that a divided highway is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must turn left or right.
You are approaching a T intersection.
The road that you are on intersects with a divided highway.
You are on an overpass above a divided highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road that you are on intersects with a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that your road meets a divided highway. A divided highway has two one-way roads separated by a median or barrier.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that a T intersection is ahead. Be ready to turn right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash means something is not allowed. This sign means you cannot turn right where it is posted.

questions.question: When a rider's left arm is bent at the elbow and pointing upward, what does it mean?
questions.explanation: Riders use hand signals to show turns or stops. A left arm bent at the elbow and pointing upward means the rider plans to turn right or change lanes to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the direction traffic must go on a one-way street. You must obey this sign.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a specific number of occupants.
Specific turning movements are allowed from specific lanes.
Drivers in both lanes are responsible for merging smoothly.

questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a specific number of occupants.
questions.explanation: This sign marks a high occupancy vehicle (HOV) lane. HOV lanes are only for buses and vehicles with the required number of passengers shown on the sign.

questions.question: You see a "Merging traffic" sign on the freeway. What should you do?

options.text: Always remain at your present speed.
Speed up to avoid congesting traffic.
Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.
questions.explanation: Make room for cars entering the freeway. If no one is next to you, move to another lane to help traffic merge safely.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals help riders communicate when riding in groups. This signal means "follow me."

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: All traffic must go straight ahead.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: A road joins from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of an intersection ahead. A road is joining from the right.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?

options.text: No turns are allowed on this road.
The road may be slippery when wet.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road has multiple curves ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the road ahead is now divided by a center barrier or median. Stay to the right of the divider.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow sign with black markings warns you that traffic is coming from the opposite direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow sign warns you of a steep hill ahead. Reduce your speed to protect your brakes and avoid collisions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows a pedestrian crossing ahead. Watch for people crossing and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are entering a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may proceed if the way is clear.
Come to a complete stop before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are entering a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: If you drive past this sign, you are going the wrong way and risk a head-on crash. Turn around carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a four-way intersection is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Trucks are permitted on an upcoming narrow bridge.
The bridge ahead is open to one-way traffic only.
The bridge ahead is wide enough for only one car at a time.
The bridge ahead may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck.

questions.correctAnswerText: The bridge ahead may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck.
questions.explanation: This yellow sign warns you that an upcoming bridge may be too narrow to safely pass a truck. Be careful and aware.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a traffic light is coming. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign warn drivers about?

options.text: The right lane ends and traffic must merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane ends and traffic must merge left.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that the right lane is ending. Traffic in the right lane must move to the left lane.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must drive at the speed shown.
The highest legal speed on this road is 55 mph.
You must drive through the intersection at the posted speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highest legal speed on this road is 55 mph.
questions.explanation: This is a speed limit sign. It shows the highest speed you can legally drive on this road. When it rains, snows, or roads are icy, you should drive slower than the posted limit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Circular signs warn you about railroad crossings. This sign tells you a railroad crossing is coming. Look for trains before crossing the tracks.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that the right lane will end ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must and must not do. This sign means you cannot turn right here.

questions.question: What does this black and yellow sign mean?

options.text: The road to the right is one-way only.
Detour to the right due to roadwork ahead.
Slow down because the road ahead turns sharply.
There is a crossroad to your right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down because the road ahead turns sharply.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road ahead makes a sharp turn (to the right in this case). Slow down before the turn, just like you would at an intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs alert you to upcoming road conditions and dangers. They are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that an intersection is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs alert you to upcoming road conditions and dangers. They are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that the road curves ahead.

questions.question: What can you do from the center lane?
questions.explanation: This sign shows a lane reserved only for left turns from either direction. You cannot use this lane to pass other cars or to drive straight through.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Highway changes ahead and to the right.
Hiking trails ahead and to the right.
Hotel ahead and to the right.
Hospital ahead and to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Hospital ahead and to the right.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that a hospital with emergency services is to the right.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: You can use hand signals instead of or with your turn signals to show what you plan to do. If your left arm is bent at the elbow with your hand pointing down, it means you are slowing down or stopping.

questions.question: A yellow and black diamond-shaped sign does what?

options.text: Warns you about conditions on or near the road.
Helps you find cities and towns ahead.
Tells you about traffic laws and rules.
Tells you about road work ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Warns you about conditions on or near the road.
questions.explanation: Warning signs have a diamond shape with black words or pictures on a yellow background. They tell you about road conditions ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and get ready to stop.
Stop completely, then go only if it is safe.
Go carefully through the intersection. You may not need to stop.
Stop only for cars on the other road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely, then go only if it is safe.
questions.explanation: At a stop sign, you must stop completely. Then you can go only when it is safe to do so.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is an object on the road.
Traffic is coming from the right.
The road curves sharply to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves sharply to the left.
questions.explanation: This chevron sign shows the direction the road curves. Multiple chevron signs may appear throughout a curve to guide you.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign means you cannot park here.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When riding in a group, the lead rider extends their left arm straight out with palm up, then swings the arm upward to signal riders to go faster.

questions.question: This sign warns of what?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a road crosses ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are near.

questions.explanation: This sign shows where bicycles regularly cross or ride. Drive carefully in these areas.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Slow down when the road is wet.
The road curves in several directions.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down when the road is wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns the road is slippery when wet. Slow down, avoid sudden braking or turning, and increase distance from the car ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Stay on the side shown by the arrow.
You can drive in the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay on the side shown by the arrow.
questions.explanation: This "Keep right" sign tells you to drive to the right of an island, median, or barrier ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The bridge ahead has low clearance.
Two-way traffic is about to merge.

questions.correctAnswerText: The bridge ahead has low clearance.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the bridge ahead is low. Do not pass if your vehicle is taller than the height shown.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road curves right ahead. Slow down to 35 mph.
A divided highway starts ahead. Slow down to 35 mph.
Merge ahead. Slow down to 35 mph.
Winding road ahead. Slow down to 35 mph.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right ahead. Slow down to 35 mph.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road curves to the right. You must slow down to the safe speed shown on the sign (35 mph in this case).

questions.question: What is the main danger of this sign?

options.text: Your headlights will be out of alignment because one side of your car is higher.
You might damage a tire by drifting onto the shoulder.
You might hydroplane if the shoulder is wet.
You could lose control of your vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: You could lose control of your vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the shoulder is lower than the road. If one wheel drops onto the low shoulder, do not brake hard or turn sharply. This could cause you to lose control. Stay calm and steer gently back onto the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the divided highway ends ahead. You will soon meet oncoming traffic.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right at this location.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a low railroad crossing. The tracks cross the road at a steep angle. The bottom of low vehicles may drag or catch on the tracks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Traffic will merge in from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic will merge in from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that other vehicles will be merging onto the road from the right side.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at the start of one-way streets and ramps. It means you must not drive in this direction.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are entering a one-way street the wrong way.
Do not drive in this lane.
When turning left on green, you must yield to oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: When turning left on green, you must yield to oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign works with a traffic light. It tells drivers that left-turning traffic must wait for oncoming traffic to pass. You do not have the right-of-way.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines are doubled in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They prepare you for hazards ahead. This sign warns that bicycles may cross the road.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You may turn right after a complete stop.

questions.explanation: This is a regulatory sign. It shows rules that you must always obey. Right turns are not permitted where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that the road is slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows that a divided highway is starting ahead. The road splits into two one-way roads separated by a barrier. You must stay in the right lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The highway ahead curves only to the right.
The highway ahead turns sharply to the right.
The highway ahead curves to the right and then to the left.
The highway ahead curves to the left and then to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead curves to the right and then to the left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs alert drivers to upcoming hazards. They are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns that the road curves right and then left.

questions.question: When you see this sign, what must you do?

options.text: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
Slow down without coming to a complete stop.
Stop completely and wait for a green light.
Slow down and check for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
questions.explanation: All eight-sided signs are stop signs. You must stop completely and look for pedestrians and cross traffic. Wait until the intersection is clear before moving forward.

questions.question: If you see this sign, what can you do?

options.text: May pass a slow-moving vehicle if you can do so quickly.
May pass if you know the road ahead.
May pass, but only at night.

questions.explanation: Regulatory signs are white rectangles with black markings. Drivers must follow all instructions on regulatory signs. Where this sign is posted, passing is not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red line through it means an action is prohibited. U-turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that a school crossing is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means it is unsafe to enter the road or driveway from your direction. Turn around and take a different route.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs alert drivers to upcoming hazards and are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns drivers to be careful when the road is wet and slippery.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs alert drivers to upcoming hazards and are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns drivers that there is low clearance ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts drivers that traffic is merging from the right. Be ready to allow merging traffic to enter safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: U-turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts drivers to an upcoming traffic signal. Be ready to stop for a red light or respond to a yellow light.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that deer cross the road in this area. Slow down, stay alert, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a flagger is ahead controlling traffic in a construction area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow diamond warning sign alerts drivers to an upcoming steep hill. Be ready to adjust your speed to drive safely.

questions.question: This is a __________ sign.
questions.explanation: This triangular sign is a "Yield" sign. Slow down and check for traffic. Give the right-of-way to pedestrians and cross traffic. Stop only if necessary.

questions.question: What does this road sign show?

options.text: The maximum safe speed for a residential area.
The maximum safe speed for an expressway exit.
The maximum safe speed for an expressway entrance.
The maximum safe speed for a work zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe speed for an expressway exit.
questions.explanation: This advisory speed sign shows the maximum safe speed for a highway exit (in this example, 30 mph).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed in this location.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Sharp right turn in the road ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Sharp right turn in the road ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a sharp right turn ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed where it is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a warning sign. Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They tell drivers about upcoming hazards. This sign warns that the divided highway is ending.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed where it is posted. Do not make a U-turn at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a regulation sign. It tells drivers what traffic rules they must follow. Where this sign is posted, U-turns are not permitted.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the overpass ahead has low clearance. Do not proceed if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign (13 feet 6 inches in this case).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Lane ends or roadway narrows ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane ends or roadway narrows ahead.
questions.explanation: This is a warning sign. Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. This sign warns that the right lane is ending or the road is narrowing ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
The road ahead turns sharply left, then right.
The road ahead curves to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead will turn sharply to the right and then to the left.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and yield for trains.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield for trains.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a railroad crossing ahead. Always slow down at railroad crossings. Trains cannot stop for cars, so you must wait for trains to pass before crossing the tracks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.
Don't park on the right side of the street.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a slash over a symbol means that action is not allowed. This sign means right turns are not permitted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a warning sign. Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns drivers that a winding road is ahead and to adjust their speed.

questions.question: What is the correct order of a traffic light from top to bottom?
questions.explanation: Red is always on top and green is always on the bottom of a vertical traffic light. When arranged horizontally, red is on the left and green is on the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A three-sided sign warns you to slow down at an intersection. Be ready to stop and let other drivers or pedestrians go first. You can proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Cars in right lane must slow down.
Pass only in the right lane.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that two lanes of traffic are about to become one lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep hill is ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep downhill section is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to stay to the right of the divider ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.
Drive with caution and be ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop and wait for vehicles and pedestrians to clear before you go.

questions.question: What does a green arrow on a lane control signal mean?

options.text: No traffic is allowed in this lane.
You must merge into this lane.

questions.explanation: A steady green arrow pointing down over a lane means you may use that lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep hill is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Eight-sided signs mean you must stop. Come to a complete stop and let other drivers and pedestrians go first. You can proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign above your lane mean?

options.text: You can continue straight or exit the freeway.
You can stay in your lane and continue straight.
You must exit the freeway if you stay in your lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must exit the freeway if you stay in your lane.
questions.explanation: An "Exit only" sign means this lane does not continue through the interchange. It becomes an exit ramp. If you are in this lane, you can change lanes to go straight, or you must exit the freeway.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You can turn right or go straight.
You can turn left or go straight.

questions.correctAnswerText: You can turn right or go straight.
questions.explanation: From this lane, you must either turn right or continue straight.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road ahead has a series of curves and turns.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to stay in the right lane to avoid a hazard ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Construction workers on or near the road.

questions.explanation: Yellow diamond-shaped warning signs alert you to hazards. This sign warns that pedestrians may be crossing the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means when turning left at a green light, you must yield to oncoming traffic. You can complete your turn when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When your left arm is bent at the elbow and pointing upward, it signals a right turn or lane change to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
